scope: MuJoCo simulation engineering adapters for preserved networks; no calibrated biological, task or cross-engine transfer assertion
binding: ordered physical names mapped explicitly to preserved ordered neural IDs; distinct BANC/FAFB snapshots and bindings; no resizing or rewriting
clock: 2ms source steps; startup name/layout negotiation uses the bounded launcher readiness budget; steady-state 5s transport fault and 100ms source-age actuation expiry unchanged

motor.encoding: bounded signed weighted spike accumulation, no oscillator; a spike history sets a target about the joint midpoint, and empty initial output has no active servo drive
motor.silence: filters decay, old source responses expire; reset/disconnect inhibits output
motor.position_gains: hexapod kp=.5 kv=.025; flies kp=.01 kv=.0005; NAO kp=1 kv=.05; fish kp=.002 kv=.0001. Native force limits are never scaled up
motor.range_provenance: Webots named servo ranges/torques for hexapod and fly; fish paired tail/fin surrogate ranges derive from declared source channels where present; NAO remains original primitive revision-unspecified surrogate
motor.velocity_limits: Active drive is inhibited above the declared speed when its position error would accelerate further; braking and passive impact velocity remain physical. NAO/unspecified virtual fin velocities assume4rad/s.

senses.inertial: body proper acceleration [-20,20] m/s2 and gyro[-10,10] rad/s; flies/fish map native XYZ to legacy X,Z,-Y; hexapod/NAO use native Z-up axes. Exact mounted-frame/cross-engine calibration remains open.
senses.contacts: actual named native body contacts including substrate; NAO FSRs use actual contact constraint forces in foot-body axes, [-100,100]N
senses.range: mounted native rays, 1-distance/reach; hexapod sonar interpolates original [0,1000],[.4,620],[.8,280],[1.2,120] lookup
senses.optics: one native material-luminance ray per receptor using camera mounts/frustum, not rendered RGB-camera equivalence; log gain9, threshold.08, baseline blend.35, leak45ms, refractory12ms, hysteresis.02, reset scale.25
senses.fish: eye luminance/absolute gradient; lateral/flow channels use measured local relative water speed with zero background flow; pressure uses actual depth/pitch. These replace the old proximity placeholders and require retraining/calibration for task transfer
senses.chemical: olfactory/chemical names remain ideal proximity proxies; no measured chemistry

hexapod.projection: 34/18 with six named legs, three servos each; native surrogate geometry retained, exact range/torque from source
hexapod.output_map: one named output per servo; no programmed twitch or gait in AARNN mode

drosophila.projection: 418/48 separately mapped to each dataset's imported IDs; both original snapshots unchanged
drosophila.motor_map: proposed six legs in lf/lm/lr/rf/rm/rr order, each eight outputs forming four antagonistic joint pairs. All48 outputs contribute. Wings additionally use legacy seed pairs (3,17)/(11,29) with coefficients .62/-.38. This is a versioned new engineering readout, not measured innervation or Webots trajectory parity
drosophila.flight: shared quasi-steady panel force at each actual articulated wing COM, area .0025m2 each, density1.225kg/m3; no aggregate spike lift or oscillator; measured insect flight remains open

nao.projection: 250/40 exact names from preserved snapshot; head, limb and phalanx channels distinct
nao.geometry: original articulated primitive surrogate; no OEM CAD imported
nao.ranges: head yaw +/-2.08, head pitch[-.67,.51], phalanges[0,1], other joints+/-1.2rad are explicit surrogate assumptions; exact OEM revision/servo calibration open

zebrafish.projection: 32/32; eight paired tail muscles, four pectoral outputs, four paired fin groups, jaw, two opercula and trunk co-contraction
zebrafish.water: surface Z=.4m bottom Z=0; rho1000kg/m3, assumed displaced volume=body_mass/rho per link; Cd1 quadratic translational drag at COM with area=volume^(2/3); 12mm linear submergence envelope
zebrafish.stiffness: named trunk stiffness output enables neutral tail position compliance and multiplies gains by1..5; force limits stay fixed
zebrafish.limits: uniform neutral density, drag coefficient, submergence and fin geometry are explicit engineering assumptions. No validated larval fluid mechanics, swimming skill or rotational hydrodynamic calibration
